scope: All test-server completed traces; not necessarily one Sub2API account
window_basis: Trace completion time in [since,until); snapshots must not be added across overlapping windows

post_fix_test_server.basis: Started after deployment and completed before until

sub2api.sample_note: No usage records above the prior high-water ID; numeric aggregate statistics unchanged. Full account export and independent historical pricing check not performed.

cache_assessment: No new trace or cache diagnostic. No new long-session cache evidence.
monitor_assessment: No newly actionable anomaly. No new completed trace or account-94 bill; aggregate token counts and USD unchanged. Containers remain running with expected images and zero restarts. Two existing downstream 502 records unchanged.

deduplication.known_coverage_limitation: Only first-page high-water comparison; CLI full pagination authentication not configured; no new access blocker.

boundaries: Credits cover all test-server traces; USD covers only the selected Sub2API account.
Simulated cache usage is not an upstream cache measurement; USD is not Kiro credits.
No shared request ID: pairs are inferred using model, finish time and token counts; ambiguous rows remain unpaired.
Derived unit prices describe recorded costs; only supplied dated price rules independently check unit prices.
Account USD applies its own base cost and multiplier; it is not verified against upstream cash costs.
Diagnostics cover at most 5000 log lines and 50 recent cache events, not every request.
Success covers finalized Kiro traces; Sub2API errors before reaching Kiro and active requests are not observed.
Only first-page rows after prior high-water ID were retained; this is not a full account history export.
At midnight the visible UI date filter was refreshed to 2026-10-10 through 2026-10-11. Account totals and test-server totals have different scopes and were not forced equal.
No inference requests, online configuration changes, credential extraction or raw-log persistence in this pass.

transient_interruption.assessment: The previously recorded isolated interruption was followed by a successful request; root cause remains unconfirmed.
